### Source Dossier

Here is the research evidence dossier for Daily Digest Issue 088 (October 28, 2026).

#### 1. Feminist Structure Signal
* **Proposed Title (CN/EN)**:  Cincinnati Art Museum 举办 Nancy Rexroth 回顾展：以《IOWA》档案与未公开自画像重构女性主体与低科技摄影 / Cincinnati Art Museum Presents 'Nancy Rexroth: Secrets of My Power' Retrospective
* **Source URL**: `https://www.cincinnatiartmuseum.org/about/press-room/2026-press-releases/cincinnati-art-museum-presents-nancy-rexroth-secrets-of-my-power/`
* **Publication Date**: 2026-06-25 / Opening October 2026 (Exhibition runs October 2, 2026 – January 3, 2027)
* **Verified Facts**: 
  * The Cincinnati Art Museum (CAM) presents the public debut of its newly acquired Nancy Rexroth Collection in the exhibition *Nancy Rexroth: Secrets of My Power*, curated by Nathaniel M. Stein.
  * The exhibition marks the 50th anniversary of Rexroth's 1977 self-published photobook *IOWA*, shot entirely with a $1.50 Diana plastic toy camera in Athens, Ohio.
  * Features over 150 vintage prints, personal ephemera, a 53-image carousel slide show, and previously unexhibited self-portraits printed from negatives under the artist's supervision.
* **Relevance to Muki**: Explores how low-tech, accessible photographic equipment was deployed in the 1970s to build a defiant feminist visual language centered on interiority, bodily self-portraiture, and female embodiment.
* **Proposed Section**: Feminist Structure Signal
* **Duplication Assessment**: New signal. Not present in recent issues.

#### 2. Visual Culture Signal
* **Proposed Title (CN/EN)**: 盖蒂博物馆出版与展出《Instante/revelación》：以百余幅名作与出版网络重构 20 世纪墨西哥摄影史 / Getty Museum Presents 'Instante/revelación: Moments in Mexican Photography'
* **Source URL**: `https://shop.getty.edu/products/instante-revelacion-moments-in-mexican-photography-9798887120317`
* **Publication Date**: 2026-08-18 (Exhibition on view September 1, 2026 – January 3, 2027; companion symposium October 2026)
* **Verified Facts**: 
  * Authored and curated by Julieta Pestarino (Assistant Curator, J. Paul Getty Museum).
  * Features nearly 150 photographs (1920s–2010s) by 13 prominent Mexican photographers, including Lola Álvarez Bravo, Manuel Álvarez Bravo, Graciela Iturbide, Mariana Yampolsky, and Pablo Ortiz Monasterio.
  * Structured around Octavio Paz's 1982 collaborative book *Instante y revelación*, highlighting the central role photobooks, magazines, and peer networks played in circulating Mexican photography.
* **Relevance to Muki**: Provides a compelling media archaeology case study on photobooks and printed periodicals as non-institutional infrastructure for collective image-making and artistic exchange in East Asian/Latin American comparative frameworks.
* **Proposed Section**: Visual Culture Signal
* **Duplication Assessment**: New signal. Not present in recent issues.

#### 3. China / East Asia Signal
* **Proposed Title (CN/EN)**: 泰康美术馆举办《生命在此发生》摄影展：12 位中外创作者入驻老龄社区记录日常与关护实践 / Taikang Art Museum Opens 'Life Takes Place' Photography Exhibition on Aging and Care
* **Source URL**: `https://news.cgtn.com/news/2026-10-27/Photo-exhibition-captures-modern-senior-life-in-China-1x111111/index.html`
* **Publication Date**: 2026-10-27
* **Verified Facts**: 
  * Taikang Art Museum in Beijing presents *Life Takes Place* (生命在此发生), running through November 30, 2026, curated by Shen Chen.
  * 12 Chinese and international photographers (including Zhang Xiao and Aleix Plademunt) undertook residencies in senior living communities across Hangzhou, Shanghai, and Chengdu.
  * Focuses on everyday routines, choices, agency, social connections, and care structures among older adults in contemporary Chinese urban communities.
* **Relevance to Muki**: Offers a concrete, regional East Asian examination of photography, aging, care labor, and bodily agency that moves away from passive visual tropes.
* **Proposed Section**: China / East Asia Signal
* **Duplication Assessment**: New signal. Not present in recent issues.

#### 4. AI Research / Creative Tech Signal
* **Proposed Title (CN/EN)**: Meta 发布 Open-Weight 模型 Muse-Glimmer-30B：专为端侧 Agent 与本地多模态工作流打造 / Meta Releases Muse-Glimmer-30B Open-Weight Model for Local Agent Workflows
* **Source URL**: `https://huggingface.co/meta-models/Muse-Glimmer-30B`
* **Publication Date**: 2026-10-17
* **Verified Facts**: 
  * Released under Apache 2.0 license by Meta Superintelligence Lab.
  * 30-billion-parameter causal language model featuring a dedicated perception encoder, distilled from Muse Spark.
  * Purpose-built for local execution of multi-step planning, tool use, failure recovery, and multimodal task processing on consumer hardware without cloud dependencies.
* **Relevance to Muki**: Substantially lowers the hardware and privacy threshold for integrating local, multi-step, multimodal AI agents directly into creative production, archival sorting, and publishing workflows.
* **Proposed Section**: AI Research / Creative Tech Signal
* **Duplication Assessment**: New signal. Extends previous tracking of open weights (such as Reflection AI Beam and NVIDIA Nemotron 3.5 Bolt) specifically into local-first, consumer-hardware multimodal agent execution.

* **Proposed Title (CN/EN)**: 西弗吉尼亚大学图书馆启动“工业、劳动与社区”驻留招募：利用工会档案与口述史开展创作 / WVU Libraries Launches Industry, Labor and Community Residency Open Call
* **Source URL**: `https://www.artworkarchive.com/call-for-entry/industry-labor-and-community-residency`
* **Publication Date**: 2026-10-27 (Application Deadline: November 30, 2026)
* **Verified Facts**: 
  * Organized by West Virginia University Libraries' Art in the Libraries program.
  * Award includes $1,000 honorarium, supplies, travel, lodging, and per diem.
  * Selected resident artist will develop a project using union records, company town archives, and oral histories at the West Virginia and Regional History Center (WVRHC), culminating in a library exhibition and public presentation.
* **Relevance to Muki**: Direct primary opportunity for researchers and visual artists working with labor history archives, oral history methodologies, and institutional memory.
* **Proposed Section**: Archive / Long Read / Opportunity
